purpose: Build one strictly-prior batter contact-quality input block after the true-EB-offset residual candidate showed discrimination without adequate calibration or proper-score improvement.

source.raw_hash_authority: panel_manifest.raw_source_sha256 from direct batter PA foundation v4.1
source.target_identity_source: certified v4.1 panel season/game_date/game_pk/player_id columns only
source.feature_cutoff: raw game_date strictly before target game_date

populations.joint_ev_launch_angle: finite positive launch_speed and finite launch_angle in [-90,90]
populations.speed_angle_classified: joint EV/LA row with integral launch_speed_angle in 1..6
populations.bb_type_classified: type-X row with bb_type in ground_ball,line_drive,fly_ball,popup

official_boundaries.barrel: launch_speed_angle == 6; rate is reported only over the separately serialized classified denominator
official_boundaries.ev50: mean of the hardest ceiling(50 percent) measured exit velocities

explicitly_excluded.estimated_ba_using_speedangle: The delivered field is not bound to a point-in-time algorithm/version receipt.
explicitly_excluded.estimated_slg_using_speedangle: The delivered field is not bound to a point-in-time algorithm/version receipt.
explicitly_excluded.estimated_woba_using_speedangle: The delivered field is not bound to a point-in-time algorithm/version receipt.
explicitly_excluded.hc_x_hc_y_spray_pull: Raw coordinates exist, but no authoritative park-coordinate and switch-hitter transformation is yet certified.
explicitly_excluded.maximum_exit_velocity: Single-observation maxima are not the predeclared robust tail summary.
explicitly_excluded.bat_tracking: 2023 completeness and source timing are not established.
